metadata.description: scribb.me: a writing-style plugin for docs, UI copy and newsletters. Use scribb in Claude Code and scribb-chat in claude.ai chat.

plugins.name: scribb
plugins.description: For Claude Code. Writing style for docs, UI copy and newsletters: anti-AI-writing rules, content-type conventions, optional styles, a checker loop and learned preferences.

plugins.name: scribb-chat
plugins.description: For claude.ai chat. Write and review docs, UI copy and newsletters without AI writing habits, with a built-in checker. Skills: scribb-write, scribb-review, scribb-learn, scribb-remember, scribb-styles, scribb-report.
